summary: Verified the iOS Safari cookie-drop fix: token via URL fragment #st=... hydration works end-to-end. Backend + frontend + integration all pass.

primary_fragment_hydration.details: Loaded /#st=sttest_SUQD-bH3lyJJOBLw-llOftxhxupA_9nU in fresh context (cookies + localStorage cleared). Final URL scrubbed to '/'. localStorage['n2m_token'] == 'sttest_SUQD-bH3lyJJOBLw-llOftxhxupA_9nU'. User authenticated (NOT on signin screen). App routed to community-rules screen (demo-00 lacks agreed_to_rules_at field), confirming auth succeeded via Bearer fallback — the exact iOS bug is fixed.

test_results.note_on_expected_feed_landing: Review request expected demo-00 to land on FEED, but the user's /auth/me payload does NOT include agreed_to_rules_at, so routeToNext (App.js line 92) correctly sends them to community-rules. This is a demo seed-data completeness issue (not a bug in the redirect/fragment fix). To land on feed, seed demo-00 with agreed_to_rules_at timestamp.

backend_google_redirect_error_path.details: POST /api/auth/google-redirect with credential=fake returns HTTP 303 with Location: /?auth_error=invalid_credential.

auth_error_toast.details: Loaded /?auth_error=invalid_credential in fresh context. Toast 'Sign-in failed — please try again.' displayed. URL scrubbed to '/'. signin-screen and signin-google-button both present.

regression_unauthenticated_load.details: Fresh context load shows signin-screen with google-button, no JS crashes (only expected 401 for pre-auth /auth/me poll).

regression_bearer_authenticated_api.details: GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer sttest_... → 200 (user demo-00, handle yui.tokyo, onboarded:true). GET /api/matches/unread with same Bearer → 200 {count:0}.

code_verification.details: server.py:350 sets resp.headers['location'] = f'/#st={result["token"]}' AFTER _finalize_google_signin (cookie still set on resp via belt-and-braces). App.js:169-173 reads #st=, stores in localStorage as n2m_token, and history.replaceState scrubs fragment before /auth/me call. api.js axios interceptor sends Authorization: Bearer from n2m_token.

action_items: Optional (not blocking this fix): seed demo-00 with agreed_to_rules_at so the fragment-login smoke test lands on FEED per the review's stated expectation. Auth fix itself is correct as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:350 overwrites resp.headers['location'] (was set to '/' by RedirectResponse(url='/')). The Set-Cookie header for session_token from _finalize_google_signin is preserved on the same response — good belt-and-braces. Verified no double-Location header issue.

App.js:170 uses window.location.hash.slice(4) to extract token — assumes exactly '#st=' prefix. If fragment ever contains additional params (e.g., '#st=X&foo=bar'), slice(4) would include them. Currently safe because backend only emits '/#st=<token>' with no extra fragment params.
App.js:172 uses pathname + search (drops any hash). Correct — we WANT the fragment stripped.
test_credentials: sttest_SUQD-bH3lyJJOBLw-llOftxhxupA_9nU (demo-00 / yui.tokyo, 24h expiry) worked as expected via both URL fragment and Authorization: Bearer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iOS Safari cookie-drop fix is verified. Fragment hydration path: /#st=<token> → localStorage['n2m_token'] → axios Bearer → /auth/me success. URL is cleanly scrubbed via history.replaceState. auth_error toast still works and its query param is also stripped. Demo user demo-00 lacks agreed_to_rules_at so lands on community-rules screen (not feed) — this is seed-data behavior, not an auth bug.
